page.overview:
What is Teroj's blaster?

Teroj's blaster was a blaster pistol owned by the First Order operative Teroj Kee. In 34 ABY, he wielded the weapon on the supertanker fuel depot Colossus while stealing a phase connector mining device from the platform's Office of Acquisitions. At the Colossus loading docks, he threatened the mechanic Kazuda Xiono with the blaster before returning to the Office of Acquisitions and firing repeatedly at Xiono's droid, BB-8. Aboard his freighter, he fired several shots at the gorg Bitey after the creature sabotaged the vessel.

Teroj's blaster was a blaster pistol owned by the First Order operative Teroj Kee. The weapon could be wielded single- or double-handedly for use in ranged combat and fired red blaster bolts. Teroj's blaster featured a teal blue finish and gray and silver elements on its handle, barrel, and chamber. The blaster pistol also featured brown paneling on its grip, which was fastened by two screws, and red-and-yellow lights.

In 34 ABY, Kee kept the blaster in a holster on his hip while visiting the supertanker fuel depot Colossus. Posing as a member of the Mining Guild, he sought to steal a rare phase connector mining device from the platform's Office of Acquisitions while its owners, Flix and Orka, were away. Upon approaching the mechanic Kazuda Xiono, who was helping manage the store for Flix and Orka, Kee kept his hand on his blaster as he impatiently conversed with Xiono. Upon being informed that the Office of Acquisitions could not sell him its phase connector, he was bitten by the gorg Bitey, prompting him to remove his hand from his blaster. Angrily, Kee ordered several other items to be delivered to loading dock 23 in the Colossus loading docks and left.

When Xiono delivered the requested items to the loading dock, Kee confronted the mechanic at blaster-point and locked him in the dock's storage locker. With Xiono out of the way, Kee returned to the Office of Acquisitions and used a tool to cut through its door. Wielding his blaster, he entered the store, unaware that Xiono's astromech droid—BB-8—was still inside. When BB-8 shifted behind a crate, Kee swung in the droid's direction with his blaster, though he turned away after not seeing further movement. Kee then used his blaster to fry the store's back room door controls, finding his coveted phase connector. BB-8 attacked Kee as he left with the phase connector, prompting the latter to shoot at the droid with his blaster. Kee chased BB-8 through the Office of Acquisitions, firing off several shots, though not managing to hit the droid. However, Kee eventually managed to trap BB-8 beneath a shelf and left with his stolen prize, blaster re-holstered.
